note: Reel 1 'dye pack', script approved by Kai 2026-11-10. One narrator. Styles are plain delivery words only.

lines.text: He robs a bank, and the teller HELPS him pack the bag.
She doesn't scream. She smiles, lifts a stack of twenties off a little metal plate, and drops it in.
Easiest money he's ever made. He strolls out the door.
About ten seconds later, his bag EXPLODES.
You see, that stack was hollow. Inside, a dye pack sat asleep on its magnet until she picked it up.
Now it's burning at four hundred degrees, spraying red dye on every single bill, and on him.
So he's standing in the street with a bag of worthless paper, the only bright red man in town.
